fields.name: srcLight
fields.label: Logo image (light theme)
fields.hint: Shown when the site is light. Pair it with the dark one. SVG recommended.

fields.name: srcDark
fields.label: Logo image (dark theme)
fields.hint: Shown when the site is dark.

fields.name: src
fields.label: Single logo image
fields.hint: Used when there are no light and dark images. SVG recommended.

fields.name: tint
fields.label: Match text color
fields.hint: Single-color SVGs only. Follows light/dark theme.

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Accessible name
fields.hint: Used when there is no text next to the logo.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.hint: Pick one of the provided icons or upload your own. Use a single-color SVG: it is drawn in the site's link color, so any other colors are lost. Square versions are named square-social-*.

fields.name: siteName
fields.label: Site name
fields.hint: Used in page titles, the footer and search results.

fields.name: url
fields.label: URL
fields.hint: The full address of the live site, without an end slash. Used for canonical links.

fields.name: footerTemplate
fields.label: Footer template
fields.hint: Which footer the site uses. Each is edited in its own Footer entry under Global.

fields.name: headerTemplate
fields.label: Header template
fields.hint: Which header the site uses. The links and buttons are shared, under Navigation. The look is edited in each header's own entry.

fields.name: author
fields.label: Author
fields.hint: Person or company name.

fields.name: contactEmail
fields.label: Contact email
fields.hint: Added to the site's structured data (rich results).

fields.name: themeColor
fields.label: Theme color
fields.hint: Colors the browser bar on some phones.

fields.name: faviconLight
fields.label: Favicon (light theme)
fields.hint: Shown in the browser tab when the device uses a light theme. SVG recommended.

fields.name: faviconDark
fields.label: Favicon (dark theme)
fields.hint: Shown in the browser tab when the device uses a dark theme.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Default meta description
fields.hint: Used when a page has no description of its own. Aim for 120-160 characters.

fields.name: ogImage
fields.label: Default social share image
fields.hint: 1200x630 recommended.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Meta description

fields.name: ogImage
fields.label: Social share image
fields.hint: Shown when the page is shared. 1200x630 recommended. Falls back to the site default.

fields.name: crawlPage
fields.label: Crawl page (default)
fields.hint: Uncheck to add a 'noindex, nofollow' meta tag
